circuits.title: Bell pair
circuits.detail: Read back by SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark: the circuit read back from it is exactly the same unitary.

circuits.title: Bernstein-Vazirani (secret 101)
circuits.detail: Muse Image's figure did not match the circuit after 2 corrections (it shows X on q3, H on q0, H on q1, H on q2, H on q3, CX q0→q1, CX q2→q3, H on q0, H on q1, H on q2; the circuit is X on q3, H on q0, q1, q2, q3, CX q0→q3, CX q2→q3, H on q0, q1, q2), so the exact Qiskit drawing is shown instead.

circuits.title: Bit-flip code (an error on q1)
circuits.detail: Muse Image's figure did not match the circuit after 2 corrections (it shows RY(2.09) on q0, CX q0→q1, CX q1→q2, X on q1, CX q0→q1, CX q0→q2, CCX q1,q2→q0; the circuit is RY(2.09) on q0, CX q0→q1, CX q0→q2, X on q1, CX q0→q1, CX q0→q2, CCX q2,q1→q0), so the exact Qiskit drawing is shown instead.

circuits.title: The CHSH game
circuits.detail: Muse Image's figure did not match the circuit after 2 corrections (it shows H on q0, H on q2, H on q3, CX q0→q1, RY(-0.79) on q0, RY(-0.79) on q1, RY(0.79) on q1, RY(0.79) on q0, RY(-0.79) on q2; the circuit is H on q0, q2, q3, CX q0→q1, RY(-0.79) on q0, CX q2→q0, RY(0.79) on q0, CX q2→q0, RY(-0.79) on q1, RY(0.79) on q1, CX q3→q1, RY(-0.79) on q1, CX q3→q1), so the exact Qiskit drawing is shown instead.

circuits.title: Deutsch-Jozsa (balanced)
circuits.detail: Read back by SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark: the circuit read back from it is exactly the same unitary.

circuits.title: Entanglement swapping
circuits.detail: Muse Image's figure did not match the circuit after 2 corrections (it shows H on q2, H on q0, CX q2→q3, CX q0→q1, H on q1, H on q0; the circuit is H on q0, CX q0→q1, H on q2, CX q2→q3, CX q1→q2, H on q1, CX q2→q3, CZ q1→q3, CX q0→q3, H on q0), so the exact Qiskit drawing is shown instead.

circuits.title: GHZ-3
circuits.detail: Read back by SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark: the circuit read back from it is exactly the same unitary.

circuits.title: Grover search (2 qubits)
circuits.detail: Muse Image's figure did not match the circuit after 2 corrections (it shows 3 qubits, the circuit has 2), so the exact Qiskit drawing is shown instead.

circuits.title: Quantum half adder
circuits.detail: Muse Image's figure did not match the circuit after 2 corrections (it shows H on q0, H on q1; the circuit is H on q0, q1, CCX q0,q1→q3, CX q0→q2, CX q1→q2), so the exact Qiskit drawing is shown instead.

circuits.title: Hidden shift (bent function, s = 1011)
circuits.detail: Muse Image's figure did not match the circuit after 2 corrections (it shows H on q0, H on q1, H on q2, H on q3, X on q0, X on q2, X on q1, X on q3, X on q0, X on q1, X on q2, X on q3, H on q0, H on q1, H on q2, H on q3, X on q1, H on q0, H on q1, H on q2, H on q3; the circuit is H on q0, q1, q2, q3, X on q0, X on q1, X on q3, CZ q0→q1, CZ q2→q3, X on q0, X on q1, X on q3, H on q0, q1, q2, q3, CZ q0→q1, CZ q2→q3, H on q0, q1, q2, q3), so the exact Qiskit drawing is shown instead.

circuits.title: Simulating a quantum magnet (Trotter)
circuits.detail: Muse Image's figure did not match the circuit after 2 corrections (it shows CX q0→q1, RZ(1.00) on q1, RZ(1.00) on q2, RZ(1.00) on q1; the circuit is CX q0→q1, RZ(1.00) on q1, CX q0→q1, CX q1→q2, RZ(1.00) on q2, CX q1→q2, RX(1.00) on q0, q1, q2, CX q0→q1, RZ(1.00) on q1, CX q0→q1, CX q1→q2, RZ(1.00) on q2, CX q1→q2, RX(1.00) on q0, q1, q2), so the exact Qiskit drawing is shown instead.

circuits.title: Phase estimation of T
circuits.detail: Muse Image's figure did not match the circuit after 2 corrections (it shows 6 qubits, the circuit has 4), so the exact Qiskit drawing is shown instead.

circuits.title: Quantum Fourier transform finds a period
circuits.detail: Muse Image's figure did not match the circuit after 2 corrections (it shows H on q1, H on q2, H on q1, H on q2, H on q1, H on q1, SWAP on q0, q2; the circuit is H on q1, q2, H on q2, CP q1→q2, CP q0→q2, H on q1, CP q0→q1, H on q0, SWAP on q0, q2), so the exact Qiskit drawing is shown instead.

circuits.title: Simon's algorithm (secret 11)
circuits.detail: Muse Image's figure did not match the circuit after 2 corrections (it shows H on q0, H on q1, CX q1→q2, CX q1→q2, H on q0, H on q1; the circuit is H on q0, q1, CX q0→q2, CX q1→q2, H on q0, q1), so the exact Qiskit drawing is shown instead.

circuits.title: Superdense coding (sends 11)
circuits.detail: Read back by SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark: the circuit read back from it is exactly the same unitary.

circuits.title: Superposition with a tilt
circuits.detail: Read back by SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark: the circuit read back from it is the same unitary to the precision of the angles drawn (overlap 1.00000).

circuits.title: Swap test: how alike are two states?
circuits.detail: Muse Image's figure did not match the circuit after 2 corrections (it shows H on q1, H on q2, H on q1, H on q0, H on q2; the circuit is H on q2, H on q0, CX q2→q1, CCX q0,q1→q2, CX q2→q1, H on q0), so the exact Qiskit drawing is shown instead.

circuits.title: Teleportation (deferred measurement)
circuits.detail: Muse Image's figure did not match the circuit after 2 corrections (it shows RY(2.09) on q0, H on q1, H on q0, H on q1; the circuit is RY(2.09) on q0, H on q1, CX q1→q2, CX q0→q1, H on q0, CX q1→q2, CZ q0→q2), so the exact Qiskit drawing is shown instead.

circuits.title: Quantum AND (Toffoli)
circuits.detail: Muse Image's first figure was wrong (it shows H on q0, H on q1; the circuit is H on q0, q1, CCX q0,q1→q2); after 1 correction by Muse Image, the circuit read back from it is exactly the same unitary.

circuits.title: W state (one of three)
circuits.detail: Muse Image's figure did not match the circuit after 2 corrections (it shows RY(1.91) on q0, RY(0.79) on q1, RY(-0.79) on q1, X on q0; the circuit is RY(1.91) on q0, RY(0.79) on q1, CX q0→q1, RY(-0.79) on q1, CX q1→q2, CX q0→q1, X on q0), so the exact Qiskit drawing is shown instead.
